content.text: Fear Factor: House of Fear Season 1 Episode 10 The Final Endgame Airs March 25 2026 on FoxThe excitement builds as “Fear Factor: House of Fear” reaches its thrilling conclusion with Season 1 Episode 10, titled “The Final Endgame.” This episode promises to push the remaining contestants to their limits as they confront their deepest fears. With only four participants left, the stakes have never been higher.In this nail-biting episode, the final four will face a terrifying challenge involving drowning and biting fish. Contestants will have to confront their fear of water and the creatures lurking within it. This challenge is not just about bravery; it’s about survival and determination.
